details:
Currently, content made for Quest must be compiled and bundled for Android (Quest), and content made for PC has to be compiled for Windows (PC). However, this has lead to a divide in content availability.
Some content, which already meets most Quest requirements, is not available due to the developer only publishing it for PC. Likewise, there is no seamless way to make content Quest compatible, as even the official documents instruct you to create a *separate [clone of the] project* in order to optimize it for quest.
As such, I submit that, going forward, investment in [development of] a "universal VRChat Asset" package format be made. Such a format, along with SDK changes, would allow content to be made *from the start* which supports both Quest & PC hardware.
For example, such a format, when storing avatars, would store information on what components are Quest compatible. That way, if the avatar's *design* is compatible, but its shaders or additional features [ancillary to it] are not, those could be omitted. This would extend the number of visible avatars on Quest by making it easier for developers to include Quest in their workflow.
Additionally, the SDK itself could offer the ability to specify Quest & PC variant assets under the same bundle. So if the avatar requires a lower-poly version for Quest, that model can be included in the same project as the PC version, and toggled between the two whilst sharing other features. This proposed package format could include a manifest, which identifies which portions are compatible with what, allowing VRC to download only the asset portions necessary for its client. (In app development, this is sometimes referred to as "app thinning").
Additionally, a universal framework would extend the availability of VRC to other platforms, in both 2D ("Desktop") and 3D (VR) contexts, such as mobiles, tablets, and even Macs, without having to introduce additional build environments and further fragmentation.
As it stands, VRC is not very extensible, and the method of creating content means that PC & Quest users are somewhat at ends with each other; Quest users limit the availability of content when interacting with their PC counterparts.
title: [Cross-Platform] Create a Universal Bundle Format
